transcript.content: After getting caught in rain and splashed by a car during a run, I developed persistent negative thoughts and emotions that affected my mood that day and my view of the experience, and further affected my work, social life, and daily life.

[System B PsychAgent] Thank you for sharing your current situation (After encountering rain and being splashed by a car during a run, negative thinking and emotions arose and persisted, affecting the overall mood of the day...). In our BT counseling framework, we will explore your core concerns and cognitive patterns.
